_comment: TLCTC custom incident fields for Cortex XSOAR 6.2. Import via Settings → Advanced → Fields → Upload. Each entry is one incident field. Field IDs use the 'incident_' prefix XSOAR requires for custom fields — reference them from playbooks as ${incident.tlctcCluster}, etc.

fields.name: TLCTC Cluster
fields.description: Strategic TLCTC cluster (#1–#10). Drives master-playbook routing. Set by classifier on ingestion; refined by TLCTCClassify automation.

fields.name: TLCTC Operational ID
fields.description: Machine-readable identifier in TLCTC-XX.YY form (e.g. TLCTC-03.00). Used for SIEM/SOAR correlation. Pattern: ^TLCTC-(0[1-9]|10)\.[0-9]{2}$

fields.name: TLCTC Δt (delta-t)
fields.description: Attack Velocity to next step. Pattern from Layer 3 schema: instant | ? | ~?\d+(ms|s|m|h|d|w|mo|y) | [<>]=?\d+(unit). Example: <30s, ~12m, 4h.

fields.name: TLCTC Velocity Class
fields.description: Derived from Δt. Drives the Velocity-Class router: VC-4 record-only (EDR), VC-3 auto-contain, VC-2 human-gated, VC-1 hand off to hunting.

fields.name: TLCTC Boundary
fields.description: Boundary annotation as JSON matching the Layer 3 schema 'boundary' definition: {context, source_sphere, target_sphere, transit_spheres?}. Required for bridge clusters #8/#9/#10.

fields.name: TLCTC DRE Outcomes
fields.description: Data Risk Events resulting from this incident. C=Confidentiality, I=Integrity, A=Availability, Ac=Accessibility (data present but unusable, e.g. ransomware).

fields.name: TLCTC FEC Executed
fields.description: True if Foreign Executable Content executed. R-EXEC: when true, a #7 step MUST be recorded at the execution moment. TLCTCClassify automation enforces this.

fields.name: TLCTC Attack Path (Layer 3)
fields.description: Layer 3 attack path JSON. Built incrementally during incident, validated and emitted on close by TLCTCEmitLayer3 automation. Validates against json-schemas/layer-3/tlctc-attack-path.schema.json.

fields.name: ATT&CK Techniques
fields.description: Raw ATT&CK technique IDs from source alert (T-numbers). Input to the classifier; preserved for traceability.

fields.name: TLCTC Analyst Confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the cluster classification — feeds Layer 3 metadata.analyst_confidence on emit.
